endorsements.name: Yonatan Khananshvili
endorsements.label: Chasing the GOLD: Cross Data Source Detection of Golden SAML
endorsements.description: The Golden SAML attack takes place through a complex set of steps and allows an actor to abuse the trust between on-premise and cloud components. We will deep dive into the internals of ADFS and the unique properties associated with the attack, while sharing how to efficiently detect it today through cross-correlation of different data sources over enterprise, SaaS and Cloud surfaces in addition to raising research questions about the difficulties of traditional single-surface solutions to detect it.
